question: 2026-08-11 ruling: 'the trouble ticket comes from the device that received the return to sender.' 2026-10-05: 'Any component that gets a request that it can't fill, that's a trouble ticket... every requester that gets something they can't do should throw a ticket.' CC recommends (a): the codemother case shows a broken sender can't be relied on to notice; the receiver's trouble names the caller. When a component can't fill a request, which end raises the trouble: (a) the receiver only, and the sender's raise in handle_bounce retires; (b) both ends; (c) the sender only, so 7cb1989e7825's 2026-08-11 ruling stands?
why_it_blocks: BaseShim's bounce path (handle_bounce, cairn/tools/base/shim.py:885) raises at the sender per the 2026-08-11 ruling; ruling 8h puts the trouble at the receiver. The declared-refusal child and any change to handle_bounce cannot be built until it is settled which end raises.
